games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: Pass-and-redirect goals (any clean pass that goes off a teammate's stick into the net, one-timer or tip) now get the long cinematic replay on the TV, after the normal goal celebration

Replay: frozen orbit around the whole bar, a dive down to the passer, slow-mo pass, fast to the receiver, slow-mo redirect, then a long slow-mo as it goes in while the camera pulls back to show the goal, players and the bar crowd cheering
Phones still show REPLAY with a Skip button
Every other goal keeps the normal instant replay
